Noah: ...there is a playlist? :eyes:
fridge-bot: Note: After-hours appliance sounds should be < 40dB per office policy. :bell:
Kiran: Petition to nickname the microwave 'DJ Toasty' and give it a tiny fedora. :coffee:
Asha: yes. also award it a 'Most Consistent BPM' ribbon. :ribbon:
Riley: i'll bring a paper hat. poll: fedora (:one:) vs beanie (:two:). react.
Noah: :one:
Kiran: :one:
Asha: :two: but i will accept either
fridge-bot: Logged vote count. Current tally: fedora 2, beanie 1. -bot
Noah: official lore entry: 'DJ Toasty spins at 11:59 and 00:00.' adding to #lore
Riley: Ceremony at next midnight: tiny hat placement and a 3-second toast. :tada:
Asha: love this. also possibly make a mixtape of microwave beeps?
Kiran: tagging facilities to see if we can get a miniature hat. @facilities
Noah: this is the best non-product deliverable we've shipped all quarter. :clap:
